videos.title: Wagner Leitmotives - 56 - Siegfried
videos.description:
Leitmotives from Richard Wagner's Der Ring des Nibelungen (Ring Cycle).

This leitmotif is known as "Siegfried" from Die Walküre (The Valkyrie) which is first heard in the third act. This leitmotif represents the son of Sieglinde and Siegmund, Siegfried.
